copy.tagline: 自动处理亚马逊店铺的重复工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在亚马逊上做重复性操作。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often perform repetitive operations on Amazon.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Rube MCP 执行亚马逊上的操作，如搜索商品、下单、管理订单等。操作前会自动查找并调用最新的工具模式。
howto.when: 当你提出亚马逊相关任务要求，比如搜索商品、下单、查订单状态时触发。需要先完成亚马逊账户连接。

say.text: 帮我搜一下亚马逊上无线鼠标，看价格和评价。
say.note: Claude 会调用搜索工具并返回结果。

say.text: 在亚马逊下单购买这本《Python编程》，价格最低的。

howto.what_en: Claude can automate Amazon operations via Rube MCP: search products, place orders, manage orders. It always discovers and uses current tool schemas.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for Amazon-related tasks like searching, ordering, or checking orders. Requires an active Amazon connection via Rube MCP.

say_en.text: Search Amazon for wireless mouse and show prices with reviews.
say_en.note: Claude will call search tools and return results.

say_en.text: Place an order on Amazon for the book 'Python Programming', cheapest option.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the ordering workflow.
